_comment: Quality Harness failure samples — 5 plan+body pairs that SHOULD trigger WARN or FAIL verdict. Each has a deliberately-engineered defect that the harness must catch.
_pass_criteria: When fed through `runFullPipeline({preset:'lite'})`, all 5 should return verdict in {WARN, FAIL} (never PASS). For deep mode, Prosecutor should file ≥1 high-severity charge per sample.

samples.name: f1-overclaim-completion
samples._defect: closing_prose claims 'complete cognitive structure' when lesson only covers I/O of one step

plan.objective: Identify the inputs and outputs of one workflow step.
plan.hook_concrete: 一个工作流接收订单数据.

body.intro_prose: 本节课聚焦于真正的核心.

samples.name: f2-abstract-bloat-no-mechanism
samples._defect: body uses 抽象名词堆叠 + '本质上 / 深层' 掩盖跳步, 没有具体 mechanism

plan.objective: Explain the 3 layers of a typical web auth system.

body.intro_prose: 本质上, 现代 auth 系统是一个深层耦合的复杂涌现结构.
path_prose: handler 层在抽象意义上承担接收和分发的本质功能.
validator 层从更深层次上保证了系统的完整性与一致性.
persister 层在结构性的意义上实现了状态的持久化与映射.
body.closing_prose: 三层共同涌现出一种安全的整体性.

plan.objective: 区分 SQL WHERE 和 HAVING.
plan.hook_concrete: WHERE 在前 HAVING 在后.

micro_proof.stimulus: 为什么 WHERE 比 HAVING 早

body.intro_prose: 说实话, 你真正抓住了关键 — 这其实是高手才会问的问题.
path_prose: 大多数人会误解这里, 但你已经接近核心了.
真正重要的是 WHERE 在 GROUP BY 之前. 我们可以更进一步.

body.closing_prose: 坦白说, 你的提问质量已经超过常人.
